pairs.question: Quo modo egredientur boni ad uidendas poenas malorum?
pairs.derivation: Augustine poses a real interrogative ('how will the good go out to see the punishments of the wicked?') and answers it himself. The leading connective 'Sed' and the section marker '[XXII]' are dropped as scaffolding/framing, and 'Quo' is capitalized. The reply opens with a second rhetorical sub-question ('Numquid corporis motu... corporali?') rejected by 'Absit;'; this non-answering rebuttal preamble is skipped, advancing the answer's start to the operative answering clause. The answer runs to the first full stop ('per scientiam.'); what follows ('Hoc enim uerbo significatum est eos qui cruciabuntur extra futuros...') is elaboration of the same answer and is cut. The author's words 'sed egredientur per scientiam' supply the span; 'egredientur' is restored to source order and capitalized as the new first word.
